todoContent: Delegate sub-agents to populate each directory with detailed implementation contracts
functionalSummary: Created project directory structure and spawned sub-agents to generate implementation contracts for MyActuator ESP32 motor control library across protocols, firmware, motor series, and simulation.
detailSummary: Created a structured project directory for MyActuator ESP32 motor control library with subdirectories for protocols, motors (RMD-X, RH, CE M, RMD-H, RMD-L, FL-FLO), firmware (ESP32, controllers), simulation (Three.js, STEP files), docs, and contracts. Spawned 4 parallel sub-agents to generate implementation contracts defining the unified protocol layer (abstracting CAN bus, RS485), ESP32 PlatformIO firmware structure, motor-specific specifications for 6 motor series, and Three.js 3D simulation environment. PROTOCOLS_CONTRACT.md was successfully created (13883 bytes). The contracts establish the architectural foundation for the library, defining communication protocols, build systems, and motor interfaces that downstream implementation work must follow.
keyPatterns: Contract structure: Markdown files with Version, Status, Target Platform, Build System metadata headers
Motor series naming: RMD-X (Planetary), RH (Harmonic), CE M, RMD-H, RMD-L, FL-FLO
Firmware platform: ESP32 DevKitC and ESP32-S3 with PlatformIO build system
Protocol abstraction: Unified layer over CAN bus, RS485, and other communication interfaces
Simulation: Three.js web-based 3D environment for visualization and testing
